skill.name: plot-consistency-checker
skill.description: Reviews plot structure, story beats, logic flow, and narrative continuity to identify contradictions, plot holes, pacing issues, or unrealistic elements.
skill.summary: Finds plot holes, continuity errors, pacing issues, and logic gaps in story outlines.
skill.author: Amraha-Anwar

security_audit.summary: No static findings were reported, so no finding verdicts are required. The reviewed SKILL.md contains prompt-only writing guidance and no prompt injection text, executable code, network use, or filesystem access.

content.value_statement: Complex stories can develop contradictions, weak motivations, and broken timelines. This skill reviews plot materials and returns clear issues, explanations, and fixes.
actual_capabilities: Checks cause-and-effect flow across scenes and chapters.
Flags timeline conflicts, missing transitions, and pacing problems.
Compares character choices with stated motivations and arcs.
Reviews world-building rules for internal consistency.
Returns findings in an Issue, Explanation, and Proposed Fix format.
limitations: Requires the user to provide plot materials.
Does not retrieve manuscripts or external references automatically.
Cannot guarantee literary quality or market success.
May miss subtle contradictions when source material is incomplete.

use_cases.title: Pre-Draft Outline Review
use_cases.description: Find continuity problems before writing full chapters.

use_cases.title: Scene List Continuity Check
use_cases.description: Check scene lists for broken causality, unclear motivations, and pacing changes.

use_cases.title: Editorial Plot Notes
use_cases.description: Create structured revision notes that focus on story logic and continuity.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Plot Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this plot summary for contradictions, weak logic, and pacing issues. Return a table with Issue, Explanation, and Proposed Fix.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single summary.

prompt_templates.title: Scene Outline Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this chapter outline for cause-and-effect flow, missing transitions, timeline conflicts, and inconsistent character choices.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of chapter or scene structure.

prompt_templates.title: World Rules Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this fantasy plot against these world-building rules. Flag any scene that breaks magic, politics, travel, or technology constraints.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of speculative fiction rules.

prompt_templates.title: Revision Strategy Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this full story plan, rank plot issues by severity, and suggest fixes that preserve the main character arcs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning before a major rewrite.

output_examples.input: A mystery outline where the detective discovers a clue before the witness reveals it.
output: Issue: Timeline conflict in the clue discovery.
Explanation: The detective acts on information that is not available yet.
Proposed Fix: Move the witness scene earlier or add another source for the clue.

output_examples.input: A fantasy plot where teleportation is rare, but several armies travel instantly without explanation.
output: Explanation: Large-scale instant travel breaks the stated limit on teleportation.
Proposed Fix: Add a rare artifact, political cost, or slower travel route.

output_examples.input: A romance outline where the final breakup happens after no visible conflict.
output: Explanation: The breakup lacks setup, so the character choice feels abrupt.
Proposed Fix: Add earlier scenes that show tension, doubt, or incompatible goals.

best_practices: Provide a full plot summary, scene list, character arcs, and world rules together.
Ask for severity ranking when you need to prioritize revisions.
Review fixes against your intended themes and character goals before accepting them.
anti_patterns: Do not submit only a title and expect reliable continuity feedback.
Do not ask it to rewrite the whole story before reviewing the plot.
Do not ignore world-building rules when checking speculative fiction.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews plot logic, timeline consistency, character motivation, pacing, transitions, and world rules.

faq.question: Can it find plot holes?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies contradictions, coincidences, missing explanations, and unrealistic story events.

faq.question: Does it edit prose style?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on story structure and continuity, not line editing or grammar.

faq.question: What input should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a summary, chapter outline, scene list, character arcs, and any world-building rules.

faq.question: Can it help with revisions?
faq.answer: Yes. It proposes fixes for each identified issue in a structured table.

faq.question: Can I use private manuscripts?
faq.answer: Follow your chosen AI tool's privacy policy before sharing unpublished work.
